item.title: UK inflation rises to 2.9%
item.summary: UK inflation has jumped to 2.9%, as predicted by economists, due to higher fuel prices resulting from the ongoing war in the Middle East. Inflation had dropped off to 2.6% in the prior month, but the reignition in fighting sent oil prices back up towards $100 during the period, which ultimately has fed through to […] The post UK inflation rises to 2.9% appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
